scope: Chosen lexical nested USING, dotted named STRUCTURE selectors and namespace rules; no new native alias-lifetime or controller claim

implementation_choices.selectors: Named user STRUCTURE variables and dotted field paths, resolved against enclosing aliases only; selector lists do not use fields introduced by earlier selectors in the same list
implementation_choices.priority: Inner fields override matching outer fields; right-most matching selector wins within a list; unmatched outer aliases remain; restore enclosing bindings on exit; do not fall back past an uninitialized matching field
implementation_choices.namespace: Fields shadow global/local constants in bare expressions and targets; explicit function-call expressions and procedure call statements use call context; bare function names yield to matching fields; CASE labels still require compile-time constants
implementation_choices.normalization: Insert copied absolute field paths before type/call/effect/flow analysis; never resolve inserted roots again; selectors have no dynamic evaluation effects
implementation_choices.storage: Existing structure storage and stable whole-copy semantics; ordinary reference/value rules and callee lexical isolation; no structure copy introduced by USING
implementation_choices.effects: Transitive global/formal writes retain their original storage root; no counter-write bypass; ordinary routine/error/ABORT cleanup and prior effects
implementation_choices.report: using_scopes id/parent/depth, original source selectors, resolved selector paths, inherited field bindings and source-located resolved uses; using_policy describes the current contract

retained_boundaries: No indexed, grouped, function-result or call selectors; named user STRUCTURE types only
No implicit recursive field search or field-owned FOR counters
Existing type, initialization, ASCII, capacity, ownership and POSITION protection checks
No jumps into nested/sibling scopes or labels/jumps inside FOR bodies
Conservative tests remain internal for the future strict milestone; no native namespace or dynamic caller-scope claim
